Prevention: Use clean pasture seed to reduce the chance of contamination
Remove all existing hedges by cutting and digging out the roots (15cm depth) from farms
Monitoring: Perennial woody shrub, 2-5m high, erect or scrambling.
Leaves are yellow-green to green, rough, 2-12cm in length.
Flowers multicolored (yellow, orange, white, pale violet, pink or red), in dense clusters ca. 4 cm across.
Fruits are round, fleshy, 2-seeded, each 5mm wide, green turning purple then blue-black.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Removal of small infestations may be possible by cutting and digging out the roots (15cm depth)
Direct Control (Chemical): Use of chemical herbicides may lead to the development of herbicide resistance.
When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage
Cut the hedge to the soil level and allow for respouting during the rainy season.
Apply glyphosate to the active growing shoots/sprouts at 6L per ha after 4 weeks
D amine, at 2L/ha foliar application to actively growing stage, followed by digging out the roots
Tordon (Picloram 65g/L + 2,4-D 240g/L) mixed with diesel using low pressure sprayer targetting the stump to kill the roots and avoid drifts
